evidence.title: Calendar Date Picker Component in Next.js

name: Calendar Date Picker Component
summary: Calendar date picker component for Next.js projects, designed with shadcn/ui and Radix UI.
description: A copy-paste calendar date picker component designed with shadcn/ui, with single-date and date-range selection. The README walks through installing dependencies, creating calendar-date-picker.tsx in a components directory and wiring it into a Next.js page; a live demo runs on Vercel.
contains: calendar date picker component with single and range selection
step-by-step Next.js integration guide in the README
built with shadcn/ui and Radix UI
